title: Keep the evidence where it was recorded
body: TalonCV runs every model in browser workers. Recordings, transcripts and frames never leave the device, so privacy is built into the architecture.

title: Deterministic scores, optional language model
body: TalonCV's scores come from measured, time-aligned evidence. The local LLM only rewords the coaching text and is never the source of the score.

title: Say what the model cannot see
body: In TalonCV, YOLO localizes faces and nothing more. Cue evidence never infers emotion, personality or hiring suitability.

title: Keep layers from the whole depth
body: Morph keeps teacher blocks spread across the full network, late layers included, instead of truncating to the first N.

title: Compression ratio is not quality
body: Morph's evaluation guide asks for held-out perplexity, teacher–student KL, prediction agreement, throughput and peak memory.

title: Decouple control rate from inference rate
body: In OBSERV-E, a Kalman projector publishes gimbal targets at 100–300 Hz while detection runs at camera speed.

title: Speak on change, not on a timer
body: OBSERV-E's speech planner talks when the scene changes (a new obstacle, a clear path, a lost track) instead of every few seconds.

title: Deactivate instead of deleting
body: CampGrids upserts on (belt, column) and deactivates missing cells, so a re-import never wipes the selections teachers saved.

title: Enforce invariants twice
body: A CampGrids class must cover an unbroken run of belts. The UI enforces it, and so does the database function that saves the class.

title: Never authorize from an analytics store
body: Redshift does not enforce unique or foreign-key constraints, so CampGrids' AWS design keeps sign-in and authorization in RDS.

title: Select on dev, report on test once
body: ConfusionClassifier picks the model by dev macro-F1 − 0.05 × log loss, then evaluates once on an untouched test split.

title: Explanations are associations
body: ConfusionClassifier explains each prediction as TF-IDF × coefficient contributions and labels them as correlations, not causes.

title: Fail closed
body: LEAD-AI's live sync refuses to run without cohort group IDs or a durable database, so data can't silently land in ephemeral memory.

title: Every estimate cites its sources
body: Compute Collaborative marks each cost as vendor-verified or modeled, and shows its line items, assumptions and sources.
